text.en:
As an emergency measure and for the purpose of providing additional services, personnel, and
facilities under the Departments of the Interior and Justice, or otherwise, for law enforcement, including the
control and suppression of acts of violence and lawlessness arising from agrarian conflicts and the proper
enforcement of the Philippine Rice Share Tenancy Act, there is appropriated out of any funds in the Philippine
Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sum of five hundred thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be
necessary, to be spent in the discretion of the President of the Philippines.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, March 7, 1939
